briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate frontier model race with new reasoning releases

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as multiple labs release advanced reasoning models amid record funding. Regulatory scrutiny grows over safety gaps while infrastructure buildouts accelerate globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4-preview with enhanced multi-agent capabilities; Anthropic follows with Claude 4 Opus; xAI ships Grok-3 and DeepSeek launches R2. Meta open-sources Llama 4.1.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with first fines issued.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to Microsoft and Google; TSMC announces 1.4nm process for AI chips; Saudi Arabia commits $40B to new hyperscale data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like dynamic dialects prevent catastrophic misalignment before 2028?
